Day 2: Breakfast at hotel 8AM (included in room) + auto to Amber Fort ₹100 (9AM visit avoids crowds) + Amber Fort entry ₹500 + shared jeep ride up hill ₹200 (6-seater, vs walk saves energy) + explore fort 9:30-12PM (Sheesh Mahal mirror palace + sound-light setup) + Jaigarh Fort connected ₹100 (12:30-1:30PM, fort above Amber with cannon) + lunch Laxmi Mishthan Bhandar ₹400 (dal baati churma + thali) + Jal Mahal photo stop en route 2-3PM (free, water palace exterior only) + Nahargarh Fort 3:30PM ₹200 entry + sunset view 5:30PM (panoramic pink city view) + auto down ₹100 + dinner Handi Restaurant rooftop ₹700 (laal maas + tandoori) + auto return ₹150 = ₹2,550 Day 2 total. Day 3: Breakfast at hotel 8AM (included) + checkout + auto to Albert Hall Museum ₹100 + entry ₹150 (9-10:30AM, Egyptian mummy + miniature paintings) + walk to Johari Bazaar (free, 10:30AM-12PM jewelry shopping + blue pottery + textiles ₹2,000 budget for 3 people = mix of souvenirs) + lunch Peacock Rooftop Restaurant ₹600 (City Palace view, veg thali) + auto to bus stand ₹150 + bus departure 3PM ₹400pp (6hr, arrives DEL 9PM) = ₹3,400 Day 3 total. TOTAL COSTS BREAKDOWN: Transport: Bus DEL-Jaipur round-trip ₹2,400 (₹400pp × 3 × 2 ways), Local autos/jeeps ₹1,000 (₹150+₹150+₹100+₹200+₹100+₹150+₹100+₹150 across 3 days). Accommodation: Hotel ₹3,600 (2 nights, breakfast included saves ₹600). Food: Rawat ₹450 + Chokhi Dhani ₹2,700 (₹900×3) + Laxmi ₹400 + Handi ₹700 + Peacock ₹600 = ₹4,850 (breakfast free 2 days saves ₹600). Entry fees: Hawa Mahal ₹200 + City Palace ₹700 + Jantar Mantar ₹200 + Amber ₹500 + Jaigarh ₹100 + Nahargarh ₹200 + Albert Hall ₹150 + shared jeep ₹200 = ₹2,250. Activities: Chokhi Dhani experience included in meal cost (cultural show + camel ride + folk dances worth ₹1,500 but bundled). Shopping: ₹2,000 budgeted (blue pottery ₹500, textiles ₹800, jewelry ₹700). Buffer: ₹1,900 (tips, water bottles ₹150, extra snacks ₹200, contingency ₹1,550). GRAND TOTAL: ₹27,000 (₹9,000 per person, fits ₹10k budget with ₹1k spare). REASONING: Jaipur architecture focus needs ALL major forts (Amber + Jaigarh + Nahargarh = triangle of power representing Rajput military architecture). City Palace + Jantar Mantar connected tickets save ₹100 vs separate. Photography soft constraint (0.7) satisfied by: Hawa Mahal pink facade morning light, Amber Fort mirror work, Nahargarh sunset panorama, Jal Mahal water reflections - 4 Instagram-worthy spots covered. Local food constraint (0.8) met via: Rawat (iconic since 1937, locals' breakfast spot), Laxmi Mishthan (dal baati churma authentic), Handi (laal maas specialty 40yr legacy) vs tourist trap restaurants like Niros/Crystal Palm avoided (would add ₹2,000 for same quality). Chokhi Dhani (0.9 cultural experience) = massive value: ₹900 gets unlimited thali (worth ₹500) + 2hr cultural show (worth ₹700) + village setup + camel ride vs separate cultural show ₹500 + dinner ₹500 = ₹1,000 saved by bundling. TRADE-OFF ANALYSIS: ✅ GOOD: Bus vs flight - Bus ₹400pp vs flight ₹3,000pp saves ₹7,800 total. 6hr journey manageable Delhi-Jaipur (vs 16hr Delhi-Goa where flight makes sense). Leaves 7AM arrives 1PM = half day 1 usable. Flight only saves 4.5hrs (airport checkin + travel time) but costs ₹7,800 = ₹1,733/hr premium unreasonable for friends trip. ✅ GOOD: 3-sharing room vs individual rooms - ₹1,800/night triple vs ₹1,500/night single (₹4,500 total for 3 rooms) saves ₹5,400 over 2 nights. Friends traveling together prefer bonding over privacy. Individual rooms would push total to ₹32,400 (₹10,800pp) exceeding ₹10k budget. ✅ GOOD: Shared jeep vs individual jeep Amber Fort - Shared 6-seater ₹200 total (₹67pp) vs private jeep ₹600 saves ₹400. 10min ride up steep hill, sharing with other tourists is cultural experience. Private unnecessary for short distance. ✅ GOOD: Local restaurants vs tourist traps - Rawat + Laxmi + Handi (local institutions, authentic, ₹1,550 for 3 meals) vs Niros + Spice Court + 1135 AD (tourist-focused, ₹3,500 for same meals = ₹1,950 more). Locals eat at Rawat (proof of quality). 1135 AD fort setting pretty but ₹1,200/person for ambiance not food. ✅ GOOD: One cultural experience (Chokhi Dhani) vs multiple small ones - Chokhi Dhani ₹2,700 total (includes unlimited food + 2hr show + activities) vs separate: Jawahar Kala Kendra cultural center ₹300 + Raj Mandir cinema ₹600 + puppet show ₹400 + separate dinner ₹1,500 = ₹2,800 for fragmented experiences. Chokhi Dhani is one-stop immersive Rajasthani village simulation. ✅ GOOD: Walking Johari Bazaar vs hiring guide - Free self-guided walk + shopping 1.5hr vs paid guide ₹1,200 for 3hr tour. Bazaar is straightforward (one main street), Google Maps sufficient, bargaining more fun without guide pressure. ₹1,200 saved applied to shopping budget. ❌ REJECTED: Flight Delhi-Jaipur - ₹3,000pp (₹9,000 total) vs bus ₹1,200 total. Saves 4.5hrs but costs ₹7,800 more = friends budget blown. Short 6hr bus ride manageable with music/movies. Flights make sense for 15+ hr journeys (Delhi-Goa) not 6hr. VERDICT: Bus is 85% cheaper for acceptable time trade-off. ❌ REJECTED: Hotel individual rooms - ₹1,500/night single (₹4,500/night for 3 rooms, ₹9,000 total for 2 nights) vs triple ₹3,600. Friends prefer shared room bonding over privacy. ₹5,400 savings = one full extra day in Jaipur OR enables Chokhi Dhani splurge OR more shopping. Privacy not a hard constraint for friends trip. ❌ REJECTED: Taj Rambagh Palace / Oberoi Rajvilas luxury hotels - ₹15,000-25,000/night vs ₹1,800 heritage hotel. Instagram-worthy but ₹40,000+ for 2 nights = entire group's ₹30k budget. Soft constraint is mid-range stay (0.7) not luxury (0.3). ❌ REJECTED: All monument entries via composite ticket - Jaipur has ₹1,000 composite ticket (8 monuments, 2 days). Car makes sense for 4+ people or elderly, not 3 young friends. ❌ REJECTED: Elephant ride up Amber Fort - ₹1,100pp (₹3,300 total) vs shared jeep ₹200.
